title: wind chimes
description: gentle chimes that sway in the wind
body: ![banner with a wind chimes icon and the text "wind chimes"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5740b8c25e94a7653b1622ebd769850d8df181bc.png) ![bamboo, copper and iron chimes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f51d1b5a10ec99cfe5528f63d9bebfb507f6280.gif) -------------------------------------------------------------------- this mod is a faithful continuation of the original public domain [windchimes mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/windchimes) made by [hibi](https://modrinth.com/user/hibi) that adds chimes that gently sway in the wind. the goal of this project is to keep the original mod's content updated for modern minecraft versions on both fabric & neoforge. ---------------------------------------------------------------------
